home.title: Tekom: premium construction and finishing works, Stara Zagora

why.h: Build it right. Take the risk out.
why.p: Most building problems start as small shortcuts nobody sees. We work so that nothing on your site goes unseen.

r1.title: A price you can plan on
r1.text: Quantities taken from the drawings and agreed before work starts, not discovered on site.

r2.title: Done the right way
r2.text: Every layer to the manufacturer's system and Bulgarian standards, with materials you can trace.

r3.title: Nothing hidden
r3.text: Daily photos and protocols of everything that gets covered up: insulation, waterproofing, installations.

r4.title: Handover without surprises
r4.text: Signed off room by room, with documents and warranties in one place.
